description: This file defines the Delete feature for followers, including a command, validator, and handler for deleting a follower relationship by username within an ASP.NET Core project using MediatR and Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command to ensure the Username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of a follower relationship given a username, involving database lookups, validation, and profile reading.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of removing a follower relationship and returning the profile of the user.
